text: Hello {{ name }}, thank you for your support - it means a lot.
Redeem it on our [Discord]({{ discordUrl }}) with /register to get the buyer role and access to the support channels.
You can share access with up to {{ shares }} more people with /registrations share add.
If you like {{ product }}, a review helps a lot.
Missing a feature or found a bug? Tell us on the [project page]({{ productUrl }}) or on [Discord]({{ discordUrl }}).
Thank you again, and good luck with your projects!
